tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background for the dashboard, marketing pages and the redeem screen. Warm paper, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, table rows, sheets and menus that sit on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, input fills and the lead table header.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders; holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken, brand-soft, gold-soft, success-soft and danger-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata and masked numbers, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Tikka indigo. Primary actions, links, selected states and Tikka's own chrome. As text, on surface, surface-raised and brand-soft.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind brand: selected rows, info notes, the active nav item.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand fill.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The card stage: claim-page background and the back of every Tikka. Same role in both themes.

tokens.name: night-raised
tokens.usage: Pills and panels on night, such as the cards-left counter and the drop contents box.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on night and night-raised.

tokens.name: on-night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on night and night-raised.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Reward gold. Only for rewards, the claim button, the rare tier and the logo stub. Scarce on purpose: gold means something good is here.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on gold, rarity-common and rarity-legendary fills.

tokens.name: gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold as text (reward values in the dashboard) on surface, surface-raised and gold-soft.

tokens.name: gold-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background for reward summaries and the 'this drop made you ₦X' banner.

tokens.name: rarity-common
tokens.usage: Calm lilac for common and thank-you cards: the stub fill and badge. Reads on night.

tokens.name: rarity-rare
tokens.usage: Rare tier: alias of gold.

tokens.name: rarity-legendary
tokens.usage: Zobo pink for legendary cards only, on the card stage and in rarity badges. Never used for errors.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Valid code, redeemed lead, completed state; as text or icon on surface, surface-raised and success-soft. Deliberately not WhatsApp green.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the 'Valid' redeem panel and the redeemed tag.

tokens.name: on-success
tokens.usage: Text on a success fill.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Invalid code, destructive actions and errors; as text on surface, surface-raised and danger-soft. Always with a word and an icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background for inline errors.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill, such as the 'Not valid' redeem panel.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a solid 2px ring, 2px offset. Holds 3:1 on every surface; on night use on-night instead.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The reveal headline and marketing heroes. One per screen.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Reward value on the card stub, big result numbers.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, panel headings, business name on the card.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Claim your Tikka on WhatsApp. Every Tikka is a surprise.
styles.usage: Claim page copy, read on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tunde claimed a 20% off card on Monday.

styles.name: code-lg
styles.usage: Redeem codes on the card and the redeem screen.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Codes in tables and WhatsApp previews.

styles.name: serial
styles.usage: Card serial numbers and the cards-left counter, set in caps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, pip spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; card face padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding, gaps between groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section spacing on the claim page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing on desktop pages.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on marketing pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, badges, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, panels, table containers. Also the ticket notch radius.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: The Tikka card's outer corners, sheets, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Counters, rarity badges, the claim button on phones.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and menus on surface.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The Tikka card only, so it floats above the stage.

tokens.name: dur-quick
tokens.usage: Hover, press and focus feedback.

tokens.name: dur-shake
tokens.usage: Anticipation shake after the claim.

tokens.name: dur-flip
tokens.usage: Card flip and reveal.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: Card entrance: rise and settle.

tokens.name: dur-shine
tokens.usage: One idle shine sweep; repeat with a 3s pause.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Entrance with a slight overshoot.

tokens.name: ease-flip
tokens.usage: The flip: slow start, slow landing.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything else that moves.
